title: Dark mode tokens for the settings page

events.content: Introduce dark mode colour tokens in styles/tokens.css and use them on pages/settings.tsx.
Tokens added and the settings page uses them. The focus ring still has insufficient contrast in dark mode.
Fix the focus ring contrast, then check the toggle at 390px width.
Focus ring fixed. Next: check the toggle at 390px width and look for hard-coded hex colours in pages/settings.tsx.
